sources.family: Furniture Made to Belong UI card

take.thing: Three numbered round buttons 01 02 03 sit beside the piece to move between three presets, with labels pinned to points on it.
take.why: A buyer starts from a finished option instead of a blank canvas, which is the easiest first step.

differences: Presets set the size and fabric together
Labels are plain ivory not white pills
sources.removal: The visitor faces a blank canvas of choices.

take.thing: Pressing a size button changes the pencil drawing to show that size with its measurements in millimetres.
take.why: One drawing does two jobs: it proves the piece was designed and it explains the size.

differences: Measurements update live on the drawing
Ivory page not a brown frame
The drawing comes from the same photo
sources.removal: The size buttons change a number but nothing the buyer can see.

take.thing: Sizes are fixed buttons not a free slider, and the live price sits at the button that sends the enquiry.
take.why: Fixed steps keep every build makeable and the price beside the button removes the fear of asking.

differences: Ends in a WhatsApp enquiry not a checkout
Fabric chips open a weave close up
Price shows LKR not a euro figure
sources.removal: Every size is a surprise and the price is hidden until checkout.
